summary: Belite Bio filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited third-quarter 2026 financial results and a corporate update via press release, signed by CEO and Chairman Yu-Hsin Lin. No transaction terms were disclosed; the update covers regulatory milestones, notably FDA Priority Review of the tinlarebant NDA in STGD1 with a PDUFA target action date of February 12, 2027, no planned advisory committee, a Japanese J-NDA under Sakigake designation, Access Consortium filings in Singapore, the UK and Switzerland, and an uplisting to Nasdaq Global Select. This is ordinary periodic reporting, not a special situation.
